AxTableField.Name: SourceId
AxTableField.HelpText: The purchase order or transfer order number.
AxTableField.Label: Source order

AxTableField.Name: Reference
AxTableField.HelpText: Vendor packing slip id for a receipt; blank for a transfer.
AxTableField.Label: Reference

AxTableField.Name: LinesJson
AxTableField.HelpText: The captured lines exactly as the device sent them, parsed when this row is processed. A whole order can come as one posting, so no limit. Emptied once a big posting is done - see shrinkLines.
AxTableField.Label: Lines (JSON)

AxTableField.Name: ProcessedUtc
AxTableField.HelpText: When this row was claimed for processing, then when it finished - succeeded or failed.
AxTableField.Label: Processed

AxTableField.Name: ErrorMessage
AxTableField.HelpText: D365FO's own reason, set only when Status is Failed.
AxTableField.Label: Error

AxTableField.Name: GrnId
AxTableField.HelpText: The product receipt (GRN) posted with this registration, when Auto GRN is on.
AxTableField.Label: GRN

AxTableField.Name: OriginalLinesJson
AxTableField.HelpText: The lines as the device sent them, kept when a supervisor changes a quantity.
AxTableField.Label: Original lines (JSON)

AxTableField.Name: ChangedBy
AxTableField.HelpText: Who changed the quantity on this posting, or cancelled it.
AxTableField.Label: Changed by

AxTableField.Name: ChangedUtc
AxTableField.HelpText: When the quantity on this posting was changed, or it was cancelled.
AxTableField.Label: Changed

AxTableField.Name: ChangeNote
AxTableField.HelpText: The reason given for changing the quantity, or for cancelling.
AxTableField.Label: Change reason

AxTableField.Name: LineCount
AxTableField.HelpText: How many lines this posting carries. Stays when a big posting's lines are emptied.
AxTableField.Label: Lines

AxTableField.Name: Warehouse
AxTableField.HelpText: The warehouse whose stock this posting moves. Postings of one warehouse are worked in order by one batch task.
AxTableField.Label: Warehouse
